በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
አሚነ: አሚን — faith, belief (noun, accusative; from አምነ 'believe') (?)
ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
ተነበዩ: ተነበየ — they prophesied (3mp perfect, tä-stem, n-b-y)
ለወልደ: ወልድ — the son of (ለ- marking the object + noun, construct) · to the son of (ለ- 'to', dative, parallel to ለንጉሥ: ሀቦ ... ለወልደ ንጉሥ 'give ... to the king's son')
በመዋዕልየኑ: መዋዕል — in my days, in my lifetime (በ- 'in' + plural መዋዕል + -የ '1cs my' + -ኑ, read as the interrogative enclitic) (?)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
አምሳለ: አምሳል — likeness, image (construct 'likeness of') · accusative 'likenesses, types' after ብዙኀ 'many' (ብዙኀ አምሳለ 'many likenesses')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city') · accusative of place 'in the city' (ይነብር ሀገረ 'he would stay in the city')
ለመልከ: መልከጼዴቅ — Melchizedek, first element (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor)
ጼዴቅ: መልከጼዴቅ — Melchizedek, second element (proper name; written as two words)
ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ወረከቦ: ረከበ — and he found him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ዎ 'him') · the object suffix is -ኦ 'him' (ረከበ + ኦ, contracted -ቦ), not -ዎ
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
ዘተገብረ: ተገብረ — which was done (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ገብረ)
ለአብርሃም: አብርሃም — to Abraham (ለ- + proper name) · object-marking ለ- doubling the suffix of አፍለሶ (አፍለሶ እግዚኣብሔር ለአብርሃም 'God moved Abraham') · ለ- marking the owner (እኁሁ ለአብርሃም 'his brother, Abraham's')
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
በዕለተ: ዕለት — on the day of (በ- + noun, construct 'day-of')
ብከ: ቦ — there is to you, you have (existential ቦ + -ከ '2ms'; the Geʿez way of saying 'have')
አዕይንተ: ዐይን — eyes (plural አዕይንት, accusative) · construct 'eyes of' (አዕይንተ ዕዉራኒሆሙ 'the eyes of their blind', ch. 95)
ነ: ነ — our (the suffix -ነ '1cp our', written apart from ወምክሕ in the edition: ወምክሕ ነ 'and our boast')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
